info.description: Matricxon's HTTP API: Ollama-style routes under /api, OpenAI-compatible routes under /v1, and Prometheus metrics at /metrics. Errors answer as `{"error": <message>, "code": <stable code>}` (OpenAI's error shape on /v1).
info.title: Matricxon

get.description:
Does this node hold chat `tag` (pAIring's conversation id) in RAM? Routes the next message to
the node with its processed state.

delete.description:
Drops the stored prompt caches of one conversation (its `cache_tag`), e.g. after pAIring
deletes the chat.

post.description:
Moves the chat out of this node's RAM onto the shared disk (models stay loaded) so another
node can continue it. Returns once the files are written.

put.description:
Sets (or with "" removes) the admin secret on THIS node, at once and in its `.env`. Open
while no secret is set; after that it must be signed with the current one (rotation).

Sets (or with "" removes) the API key on THIS node, at once and in its `.env`. pAIring sends
it to every node of a cluster (Cluster page), or to the one server it uses.

post.description:
Turns cluster mode on/off for THIS node (the seed) and restarts it gracefully. 409 for a
joiner, 400 for a
missing folder or key. Signed when an admin secret is set; called by pAIring's admin-only
Cluster page.

Makes a fresh install a cluster joiner (409 if not fresh, 400 for unusable folders). It works
only while
the node is fresh, and is called by pAIring's admin-only Cluster page. Signed when an admin
secret is set.

Hard reset: THIS node returns to a fresh install and restarts, whatever its state (409 only
for an active voter,
unless `force=true`). Models and shared folders are untouched. Signed when an admin secret is
set; called by
pAIring's admin-only Cluster page.
A signed consensus message from another node of the cluster.

Whether THIS node can reach `address`: a new node must be reachable at its advertised address
(pAIring's 127.0.0.1 can mean something else in a container).
Makes a node a voter (a new epoch). Any voter can be asked; it goes through the leader.

delete.description: `leave=true`: removed on purpose, so it is not promoted again while it still follows.

get.description: Running and recent replies. Each call keeps stage timing on for a short while.

put.description: Changes settings without a restart; signed like the other admin routes.

post.description:
Updates THIS node from its own upstream, or from `body`'s repository, then restarts it. 409
when it can't.
